test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 15 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Fill in the blank with the most appropriate preposition:**

"The defendant was charged ______ colluding with foreign agents to influence the outcome of the election."
solution:
The correct answer is '**with**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The preposition "**with**" is used to indicate involvement or association in a particular activity or situation.
 
• The sentence describes the defendant’s involvement in colluding with foreign agents, making "**with**" the most appropriate choice.
 
• Options 1,
